authority.rule: Source UE graph data is authoritative; TSL mappings never rewrite the evidence fields.

bridge: Dormant in the fixed SnowPines branch; no generic source FlipBook helper is connected.

Exact UE 5.8 material graph, engine noise texture, 8-sample jitter, and active Gen4 MainUpsampling/High resolve core are bound; responsive stencil, encoded mobility, and half-precision boundaries remain.

landscape: sample ten authored masks in declared layer order
apply shared T_NoiseStylized height modification to seven height layers
leave Sand, Snow, SnowGrassBlue as ordinary weight layers
normalize all ten modified weights together
replace painted result with MF_Rock by AutoCliff mask
sky: emit through opaque unlit depth-tested surface
clouds: pan UV0 by material time and Rotation Speed
sample cloud curve by texture R and multiply Strength
clip at 1/3 through masked unlit depth-writing surface

nodes.description:
How much the sparkle needs to align to our angle in order to be visible (0-1)

Basically, a higher value will make the sparkle appear less often and disappear more quickly when moving the camera.

This can be coupled with the twinkle speed for a happy medium.

Decreasing this too much will show too many sparkles at once and reveal that they're aligned on a grid and look bad.
